description: Calendar/survey year. Use for temporal split (2024 train, 2025 test); do NOT include in X.
NISR agricultural season; captures seasonal crop/handling context.
District whose persistent local post-harvest context is being scored.
Crop identity; crops differ strongly in drying, processing, packaging and storage behavior.
Farm/organization scale type; proxy for operating/storage/processing capacity.
Month of estimated harvest; captures timing beyond broad season labels.
Number of plots on which the farmer grows the crop; handling/fragmentation scale.
Total sampled plot area for this farmer-crop; pre-loss scale/exposure proxy.
Mean number of crops on relevant plots; proxy for intercropping/handling complexity.
CHIRPS rainfall in 30 days before estimated harvest.
CHIRPS rainfall in 14 days after harvest historically; use forecast in live scoring.
Number of >=1mm rainy days after harvest historically; use forecast in live scoring.
NASA POWER mean relative humidity in 7 days before harvest.
NASA POWER mean relative humidity after harvest historically; use forecast in live scoring.
NASA POWER mean temperature after harvest historically; use forecast in live scoring.
Continuous target: (storage + processing + packaging loss) / total crop production * 100.
